name: Broken Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that God draws near to those with broken and contrite hearts, offering salvation and comfort in their distress (Psalms 34:18). The psalmist acknowledges that a broken spirit and contrite heart are the sacrifices God values, emphasizing humility before Him (Psalms 51:17). God is portrayed as the strength and refuge for the weary heart, providing healing and restoration to those who are broken (Psalms 73:26; Psalms 147:3). Believers are called to trust in the Lord wholeheartedly, relying not on their own understanding but on His sustaining power and righteous help (Proverbs 3:5; Isaiah 41:10).
